note: A machine route signed by GitLab. The probe sends no signed event (a real one would write an OASIS row to the shared database); it proves the route is mounted and refuses an unsigned request with JSON, whether or not the staging key is set.

tests.name: an unsigned POST to the GitLab webhook route is refused with JSON 401 (mounted, not 404 or HTML)

tests.reason: The signed paths (mapping, dedupe, 503 on an OASIS failure) need a signing key and would write OASIS rows on staging; Jest covers them.
